blurb: Danbury Ice Arena operates twin ice rinks year-round for public skating, hockey, freestyle figure skating, and roller skating in summer. They host professional hockey games and offer birthday parties, fundraising events, and suite rentals. The arena includes an arcade, bar, restaurant, and luxury suites.
